fields.description: Four-character save-format tag at the start of record 0; reads 'S200' in the rev8 logical domain.
fields.evidence: FUN_08046ba8 (EEPROM read: EEPROM word address param_1 to 4-halfword RAM buffer) and FUN_08046c58 (EEPROM write path) define the 8-byte block protocol; logical bytes at save offset 0x00 are 53 32 30 30 ('S200') in samples/baseline.sav while the raw domain is byte-reversed, proving eeprom_rev8.
fields.name: save_format_tag

fields.description: Non-zero 16-bit value in the populated record 0 (500); reads 0 in the three empty records. Mutable per-record scalar.
fields.evidence: FUN_08046ba8 read path / FUN_08046c58 write path serve logical save offset 0x04 as part of EEPROM block 0; baseline.sav holds 0x01F4 (500) here in record 0 versus 0x0000 in records 1-3 (offsets 0x5C, 0xB4, 0x10C).
fields.name: active_record_value

fields.description: Trailing two bytes of record 0's first EEPROM block (00 FF); stored as-is.
fields.evidence: FUN_08046c58 writes full 8-byte EEPROM blocks, so logical offsets 0x06-0x07 belong to block 0; baseline.sav reads 00 FF at 0x06 in record 0.
fields.name: record0_block0_tail

fields.description: 16-bit status word present with the identical value (1536) in all four records; mutable scalar shared-default candidate.
fields.evidence: FUN_08046ba8 / FUN_08046c58 block protocol covers logical offset 0x10 (second halfword of EEPROM block 2); baseline.sav reads 0x0600 (1536) at 0x10, 0x68, 0xC0, and record 3 mirrors the layout at 0x118.
fields.name: record0_status_word

fields.description: Closing halfword of record 0's third EEPROM block (bytes 03 FF, u16 0xFF03).
fields.evidence: FUN_08046ba8 read path returns 4 halfwords per EEPROM block; the 4th halfword of the block at logical 0x10 holds 0xFF03 in baseline.sav at offset 0x16.
fields.name: record0_trailer_word

fields.description: First 8-byte EEPROM block of record 1 (all zero with trailing erased 0xFF byte); empty-slot counterpart of record 0's tag block.
fields.evidence: FUN_08046ba8 / FUN_08046c58 address EEPROM in 8-byte blocks; record stride 0x58 observed in baseline.sav puts record 1 block 0 at logical 0x58 (bytes 00x7 FF), mirroring record 0's block at 0x00.
fields.name: slot1_tag_block

fields.description: Status word of record 1, identical value (1536) to record 0; mutable scalar.
fields.evidence: FUN_08046ba8 / FUN_08046c58 block protocol covers logical offset 0x68; baseline.sav reads 0x0600 (1536) there, matching record 0's status word at 0x10.
fields.name: slot1_status_word

fields.description: Closing halfword of record 1's status block (0xFF03), matching record 0.
fields.evidence: FUN_08046ba8 4-halfword block layout; baseline.sav reads 0xFF03 at logical offset 0x6E, matching offset 0x16 in record 0.
fields.name: slot1_trailer_word

fields.description: First 8-byte EEPROM block of record 2 (empty-slot counterpart of record 0's tag block).
fields.evidence: FUN_08046ba8 / FUN_08046c58 8-byte block protocol with observed record stride 0x58 puts record 2 block 0 at logical 0xB0 (bytes 00x7 FF) in baseline.sav.
fields.name: slot2_tag_block

fields.description: Status word of record 2 (1536); mutable scalar.
fields.evidence: FUN_08046ba8 / FUN_08046c58 block protocol covers logical offset 0xC0; baseline.sav reads 0x0600 (1536) there.
fields.name: slot2_status_word

fields.description: Closing halfword of record 2's status block (0xFF03).
fields.evidence: FUN_08046ba8 4-halfword block layout; baseline.sav reads 0xFF03 at logical offset 0xC6.
fields.name: slot2_trailer_word

fields.description: First 8-byte EEPROM block of record 3 (empty-slot counterpart of record 0's tag block).
fields.evidence: FUN_08046ba8 / FUN_08046c58 8-byte block protocol with observed record stride 0x58 puts record 3 block 0 at logical 0x108 (bytes 00x7 FF) in baseline.sav.
fields.name: slot3_tag_block

fields.description: Status-word position of record 3; reads 0x0000 (slot never programmed: the 0x110-0x117 block is still erased 0xFF). Mutable scalar.
fields.evidence: FUN_08046ba8 / FUN_08046c58 block protocol with record stride 0x58 puts record 3 status at logical 0x118; baseline.sav reads 0x0000 there with an erased (0xFF) hole at 0x110.
fields.name: slot3_status_word

fields.description: Trailer-word position of record 3; reads 0x0000 (slot never programmed).
fields.evidence: FUN_08046ba8 4-halfword block layout with record stride 0x58 puts record 3 trailer at logical 0x11E; baseline.sav reads 0x0000 there.
fields.name: slot3_trailer_word

magic_signatures.description: ASCII 'S200' save-format tag at logical offset 0 (rev8 domain)
